acceptance_results.evidence: Classification remains derived only from ledger rows and was not touched by the fix: classify() resolves evidence, then source, then execution, then artifact; ReportRequest/EvidenceRequest/ClaimRequest still carry no data_mode or execution_type field and reject extra kwargs; all six typing tests pass in the PASS run. The remaining node-only simulated FACT defect is a claim-tier rejection gap, recorded under T12-AC2 exactly as review 1 recorded the execution_refs form of the same gap; the report's data_mode is still correctly SIMULATED (the mock execution is seen in the ledger), so no caller-supplied label or relabel bypass is involved.

The gate run has 32 tests (9 new), 0 failures/errors/skips, and its 32 testcases are exactly the acceptance map's 32 nodeids. Independently re-ran the T12 suite in the canonical container: 32 passed, exit 0; make lint clean (ruff all checks passed; pyright 0 errors/0 warnings/0 informations). Review-1 findings verified closed at code and test level. F1: MISSING_CITATION for every claim type (builder.py:340-358); test_an_uncited_claim_is_a_conflict[fact|inference|hypothesis] yields REPORT_CONFLICT, no evidence refs/claims persisted, and certified_json() raises. F2 for execution_refs: simulatedness now derives from cited executions and their backend jobs (builder.py:404-427 and _simulated_execution_refs at 570-603); test_a_fact_resting_on_a_mock_execution_is_a_conflict, test_a_mock_backend_job_makes_its_execution_ref_simulated and test_a_real_evidence_fact_with_a_mock_ref_is_a_conflict pass. F3: execution_node_id is resolved against DAG nodes and executions; unknown node -> FABRICATED_EXECUTION and the count is checked only for known nodes (builder.py:497-545; test_an_unknown_execution_node_is_a_conflict[none|zero]). The execution_ref loop (builder.py:467-485) runs regardless of evidence_ids, so a claim with evidence_ids plus an unresolvable execution_ref also gets FABRICATED_EXECUTION and is rejected; the gated test covers the ref-only form (test_fabricated_execution_reference_is_a_conflict). F4: evidence rows with missing source_refs produce an evidence-level FABRICATED_SOURCE and dependent claims are rejected (classification.py:170-242; builder.py:128-140; test_evidence_naming_a_missing_source_is_a_conflict). F5: reviews are fetched ORDER BY created_at, review_id (classification.py:145-151), and test_two_reports_over_one_ledger_render_the_same_facts now gives two reviews the same created_at and asserts deterministic tie ordering and identical rendering. Conflicts are persisted with asserted/actual/original records and the failing claim rows are not written (verified in the cited tests). However, one reachable verification bypass remains: a FACT claim citing only execution_node_id with a count on a mock-only node is certified because simulatedness is derived only from execution_refs (finding F7). AC2 is therefore not complete.

The fix adds no tables, columns or migration: MISSING_CITATION is a new ReportConflictCode value stored inside the existing scientific_reports.conflicts JSONB, and alembic still has a single head (a4d2e6f8b1c3). The 32-test gated suite still contains test_report_tables_are_outside_the_updatable_set and test_raw_update_and_delete_are_refused_for_every_report_table, which pass against real PostgreSQL, and test_reports_and_commentary_are_project_scoped still passes. guards.install and UPDATABLE_TABLES are unchanged. The migration blob (46d88efd7288101dc920860438dfef8e2b6cb930) was verified unchanged and applied 7e4c1b2a9d3f -> a4d2e6f8b1c3 with exit 0 in run-20261020-111136/cmd-01.txt; the PASS run's alembic command was a no-op on a database already at head. The commentary composite-FK gap remains advisory and documented in the tasklog (finding F6).

The 9 new tests and the changed fixtures use the same real-PostgreSQL integration fixtures; a_review() writes through ReviewRepository.submit and the new claims/evidence/executions are production repository rows. MemoryStore remains the only doubled boundary (ArtifactStore); no live network usage was added to src/ravel/reports or tests/premium/T12. The PASS manifest records data_mode REAL and external_resources []. The two new simulated scenarios use mock-compute/slurm backend values in real ledger rows, which is the intended fixture/double policy for the compute/lab V0 boundary.

findings.trigger: A FACT ClaimRequest with execution_node_id set to a node that exists in the project DAG, execution_count=1, no evidence_ids and no execution_refs is accepted when that node's only execution has backend='mock-compute'. MISSING_CITATION does not fire because a node/count identifier is present (builder.py:340-345); simulated_refs is computed only from claim_request.execution_refs (builder.py:410), so SIMULATED_AS_FACT does not fire; and the count branch (builder.py:537-545) enumerates index.executions_for_node(node_id) only to compare the count (1 == 1) without checking those executions' backends or backend jobs. The claim is persisted, the report is CERTIFIED with data_mode SIMULATED, and the certified JSON claim has evidence_ids=[] because the frozen schema exports neither the node nor the count. The no-count variant (execution_node_id only, no refs, no count) is likewise certified without a simulatedness check.
findings.impact: This is the same class as review-1 F2, which was fixed for execution_refs: simulated output still backs a certified FACT claim by citing the node that produced it instead of the execution, bypassing the implementation's invariant that simulated output is never a fact. The certified export also shows a FACT claim with no visible citation, so the report is not verifiable from its JSON. The gated suite has no test for this path, so it passes while the defect remains.
findings.required_fix: When a FACT claim names execution_node_id and cites no execution_refs, include that node's executions (at minimum when execution_count is asserted; ideally for any FACT naming the node) in the simulatedness derivation using the same execution-backend and backend-job checks as _simulated_execution_refs, and raise SIMULATED_AS_FACT with the original execution records. Add regression tests for a mock execution on a known node cited only through execution_node_id plus count, and through execution_node_id alone.

findings.trigger: report_commentaries has independent foreign keys to scientific_reports.report_id (line 1968) and projects.project_id (line 1971); no constraint ties the commentary's project_id to the report's project_id. Remains open and is documented as advisory in tasklogs/T12.md.
findings.impact: A raw insert can create a mismatch. Repository read paths filter commentary by both project_id and report_id after a project-scoped get(), so there is no cross-project disclosure through the canonical path; this is a defense-in-depth gap for future writers, not a blocker for AC3.
findings.required_fix: Add a composite foreign key (report_id, project_id) referencing scientific_reports(report_id, project_id) with a matching unique key, or an equivalent trigger/check.

residual_risks: The PASS gate's alembic command was a no-op on a shared database already at a4d2e6f8b1c3. The migration blob (46d88efd7288101dc920860438dfef8e2b6cb930) was applied 7e4c1b2a9d3f -> a4d2e6f8b1c3 with exit 0 in run-20261020-111136/cmd-01.txt and is unchanged at e571fb8; the T12 gate still has no empty-database migration test.

data_mode is derived from all project executions, backend jobs and artifacts plus the cited evidence, not only the cited rows, so an unrelated simulated row makes a report SIMULATED/MIXED. The tasklog documents this conservative choice.
Fixture detection depends on the fixture: / fixture:// provenance convention; later Research/parser tasks must keep writing it for automatic SIMULATED classification.
No MCP read tool was added (optional in the task card); reads go through ScientificReportRepository.read()/certified_json()/commentary_for().

The frozen report schema has no fields for conflict details or per-claim execution_refs/count. Conflicted reports have no certified JSON, and even a real claim citing only an execution or node exports evidence_ids=[] with its basis visible only in report_claims. This limitation is what makes the F7 bypass invisible in the certified JSON and remains a general verifiability gap.
